Strength scales with stereotypicality (canonical chunks ~0.6-0.8, frame-preserving substitutions ~0.2-0.3), and the same tokens in novel compositional uses (weather-report Celsius measured 0.000, felt guilty 0.000, return the book 0.004, brown fox 0.07, abbreviation dots ~0.05) stay near silent, so the claim beats the token-identity confound (R2 69%). The Jacobian lens promotes 'cost' tokens (kurtosis 3.7, near-Gaussian) that never follow the peaks, so the effect is retrospective detection, not lookahead.
